subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons. 'Hindi speakers' are represented by the circle, ‘Urdu speakers are represented by the square, and 'Tamil speakers' are represented by the triangle. How many people can speak all the three languages?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16321ce8029ea41211a78da09a7b41131f6e230c9a7179c3425b152a7fa1cc87.png]
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41c74d753c6e1582f846ec3d021ae2627fc516022b9bd41d8f0b86d3ff4c5691.png] 

The shaded part represents "people can speak all the three languages".

So, people can speak all the three languages =** 5.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
